pagination.$description: Corner radius of a page number and of the previous and next controls (BR-10). TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Outline stroke width of a page number and of the previous and next controls (BR-13).

fg.$description: Number or icon color of a page that is not the current one.

border.$description: Outline color of a page that is not the current one.

borderHover.$description: Outline color of a page that is not the current one, while hovered: brand pink (BR-01). Draft: the hover look is not part of ADR-0028.

bg.$description: Fill of the current page: a brand pink chip, like the primary button (BR-01, ADR-0028).

fg.$description: Number color of the current page: black on the pink chip, 8.37:1 (SPEC.md §2.1 derived facts).

border.$description: Outline color of the current page: brand pink, the same as its fill (BR-01).

color.$description: Focus ring color of a page control (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of a page control (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between a page control and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of a page control (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).
